title: Home-screen widget · default
flows: F2: widget Expense → (Lock → PIN) → New expense → amount → Choose category → saved → Home
notes: “Show amounts on widget” off (default): logo + app name and the existing picker description. Nothing about money is shown.

What changed from P1: the saturated red / green blocks become two paper buttons (brand-paper, text brand-deep 8.9:1) with a small red − / green + glyph disc, so the money colours stay as cues without shouting. Radius 24 (system widget radius on Android 12+), soft shadow, a faint mint halo top-right.
The widget keeps fixed brand colours on light and dark wallpapers (not the app theme, not dynamic colour). Amounts are in the main currency, as everywhere in v4.
2 × 2: buttons side by side, each ≥ 62 × 62 dp, glyph disc above the word, so “Expense / Income” fit without truncation in EN and VI.

notes: Stretched 4 × 2: info on the left (amount 26 sp), the two buttons stacked on the right with glyph + word left-aligned.

What changed from P1: the saturated red / green blocks become two paper buttons (brand-paper, text brand-deep 8.9:1) with a small red − / green + glyph disc, so the money colours stay as cues without shouting. Radius 24 (system widget radius on Android 12+), soft shadow, a faint mint halo top-right.
The widget keeps fixed brand colours on light and dark wallpapers (not the app theme, not dynamic colour). Amounts are in the main currency, as everywhere in v4.

title: Import queue
flows: F2: Home banner → Queue → Save to Food → tap Shopping → Move to my account → Skip
notes: Queue cards: payee, content, amount (bank currency first when it differs, ≈ main underneath), the source account, a one-row category strip. A Suggested category is ringed and named on the primary button (“Save to Food”); with no suggestion, one tap on a category saves.
Two cards fit at 360 × 800 without scrolling; every action is one thumb-reach away. A note says queue items are not counted yet.
